property_summary: For any controller and product initialization, the correct C.maintenance(account) always returns the product's stored maintenance parameter (independent of controller().minCollateral()), whereas the mutant returns controller().minCollateral(), so when those two values differ the mutant yields a different return value.
change_summary: Changed maintenance() to return controller().minCollateral() instead of stored _maintenance, altering observable maintenance(account) values.
mutated_unit_code: function maintenance() public view returns (UFixed18) { return controller().minCollateral(); }
